component: LOS (line of sight); negative = away from satellite = subsidence
source: NISAR L2 GUNW (PROVISIONAL, CRID P05023) via ASF DAAC, track 34 ascending frame 20; https://nisar-docs.asf.alaska.edu/gunw
notes: Cumulative LOS displacement relative to 2026-06-28, sum of 7 consecutive pairs (2026-06-28_2026-07-10, 2026-07-10_2026-07-22, 2026-07-22_2026-08-15, 2026-08-15_2026-08-27, 2026-08-27_2026-09-08, 2026-09-08_2026-09-20, 2026-09-20_2026-10-14). Phase to cm with -lambda/(4*pi), lambda from each file's centerFrequency. Masks: coherence >= 0.3, connectedComponents != 0, isolated patches < 200 px (1.3 km2) removed (unwrapping-error guard), pixels deviating > lambda/4 (half a phase cycle) from their 720 m tile median removed, |pair| > 15.0 cm removed; pixel shown only if valid in every pair. All pairs referenced to the same window at -119.1456E 36.4532N. The ionosphere phase screen shipped in each GUNW was subtracted. A best-fit plane plus a linear elevation term (Copernicus DEM GLO-90) was removed from each pair (long-wavelength and elevation-correlated troposphere residual; this can also remove part of any valley-wide tilt). Troposphere and solid-earth-tide layers were NOT applied; residual atmospheric noise of a few cm per pair is expected. skipped 2026-06-16_2026-06-28.npz: quality=beta-precal
quality_note: NISAR data are provisional. Calibration and validation are carried out by the NISAR project (NASA-JPL and ISRO), not by our team.
